com.rakmajasurfschool.business.short_description: Manage operations, projects, and daily business workflows from one place.
com.rakmajasurfschool.business.full_description:
RAKMAJA SURF SCHOOL helps founders, managers, and service teams track operational work with clarity and speed. The app combines daily task management, operational record tracking, progress monitoring, and a business-ready dashboard in one focused mobile workflow.

Create local records, assign responsibility, monitor due work, update progress, and review performance from a simple, modern overview. Records stay on the device so teams can stay organized without creating account friction or relying on cloud sync.
